title: crataegus monogyna subsp. acutiloba
intro: Crataegus monogyna subsp. acutiloba, commonly known as hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa, characterized by its thorny branches and small white flowers. The health benefits of Crataegus monogyna subsp. acutiloba include its ability to support cardiovascular health, lower blood pressure, and improve lipid profiles. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its cardioactive, vasodilatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for heart-related issues and stress relief. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus monogyna subsp. acutiloba include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
